title: digest-scheduler
blurb: Concurrent workers double-claim scheduled digests, and stale lease owners can commit after reassignment.
brief:
A fleet of workers sends account digests from a shared job store. Two workers can claim the same due job, crashed claims never recover safely, and a slow worker can finish after its lease has been reassigned.

Read the deterministic barrier tests before editing `scheduler/core.py`. Preserve concurrency across different jobs.

**Your job:** make claims atomic and require a current, unexpired fencing generation at every delivery effect.
